_comment: The set release an official promo belongs to, which the API does not say: it files every promo under set 999. Keyed by printing_id; set_code names the release (001 Alpha, 002 Beta, ...). Printings in a release set need no entry, and manual printings give theirs in data/manual.json. Sources name a place, never a person. See registry/manual.py.

P001640.source: Community report, Sorcery Discord: prize support in the Arthurian Legends store kit.
